title: 第5章 A级！好感度负数是什么鬼？
slug: 神豪从收留精神小妹开始日进斗金
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

十多分钟后。

三人来到万达广场。

丸子举着相机，摆出各种搞怪表情。

“咔咔咔”声接连不断。

“哥，看镜头，笑一个！”

“那个...我不上镜，你们拍就好。”

江辰有点尴尬。

作为一个社恐男，他几乎不发朋友圈，更别说自拍了。

被两个精神小妹左右搂着，他瞬间成为人群焦点。

回头率高达300%！

见江辰不配合，丸子直接上手，轻捏他的半边脸颊，对准镜头。

咔——！

“耶！我和江哥的第一张合照！”

丸子看着手机照片，欣喜若狂。

不知道的，还以为她大乐透中了头奖。

【阳光明媚的一天，和我江哥出来逛街！全世界最帅的男人，没有之一！不接受反驳！】

江辰看了一眼她朋友圈的文案，心中感叹道：还是精神小妹好啊！

至少情绪价值这一块，绝对是拉满了。

三人出现在了一家奢侈品牌化妆店门口。

工位上的柜姐听到动静，缓缓起身，伸脖子一看，秀眉不由皱了起来。

男的身形高大，模样清秀，但一身打扮，却给人一种屌丝男士的感觉。

烂大街的大裤衩，洗得褪色的衬衫，快“分家”的人字拖——

妥妥的泡面宅男标配！

另外两个女孩，一个黄毛，一个粉毛，还有那极具视觉冲击力的纹身......

不用多想一秒，妥妥的精神小妹！

想到这，柜姐看向三人，眼中不禁多了几分警惕。

该不会只看不买吧？

纯白嫖？

奢侈品牌化妆店提供免费试用，之前她就遇到不少那种只试不买的客人。

而且还是老“回头客”了。

出于职业操守，她还是勉强挤出一丝笑容，朝江辰三人走了过去。

“欢迎光临，很高兴为你们服务。”

江辰微微颔首，随后就有一种回到主场的感觉。

他扫视一圈，而后对丸子二人道：

“1000元以下的，随便挑！不许给哥省钱，不然翻脸！”

“好嘞，哥！”

两个精神小妹郑重地点了点头，似乎已习惯了他的霸道。

而后双双杀向了专柜。

“哇塞，这是最新款的迪奥！”

“阿玛尼新品唇釉，我做梦都想买一套呢！”

看着各种款式新颖的化妆品，两个精神小妹就跟刘姥姥进大观园似的。

不时发出阵阵惊呼。

就没有她们不喜欢的。

这家化妆品店里都是奢侈品牌，不知甩了她们平时用的那些杂牌货多少条街。

可一看价格。

她俩不禁打起退堂鼓。

太贵了啊！

丸子看了又看，最后是江辰投来的目光，使她咬牙作出了决定。

“江哥，这款KIKO明彩双头唇釉，我很喜欢，才...才100多呢！”声音有些打颤。

之所以挑这款，是因为价格最为便宜。

江辰扫了一眼价格，顿时直皱眉头。

“才100多？怎么配得上你？”

丸子当场愣住。

Page (1/3)

More than ten minutes later.

The three of them came to Wanda Plaza.

Wanzi held up the camera and made various funny expressions.

The sound of "click, click, click" continued one after another.

"Brother, look at the camera and smile!"

"Um... I won't be on camera, you can just take pictures."

Jiang Chen was a little embarrassed.

As a socially-phobic man, he almost never posts on WeChat Moments, let alone takes selfies.

Being hugged by two energetic girls, he instantly became the focus of the crowd.

The return rate is as high as 300%!

Seeing that Jiang Chen was not cooperating, Wanzi directly took action, gently pinched half of his cheek, and pointed it at the camera.

Click——!

"Yeah! The first photo of me and Brother Jiang!"

Maruko looked at the photos on her phone and was ecstatic.

Those who didn’t know better thought she had won the lottery jackpot.

[On a sunny day, my brother Jiang and I went shopping!The most handsome man in the world, bar none!No rebuttal accepted!】

Jiang Chen took a look at the copywriting in her circle of friends and sighed in his heart: She is better than a spirited girl!

At least the emotional value aspect is definitely full.

Three people appeared in front of a luxury brand cosmetics store.

The cabinet girl at the workstation heard the noise, stood up slowly, stretched her neck to take a look, and her beautiful eyebrows couldn't help but wrinkled.

The man is tall and handsome, but his attire makes him look like a loser.

Big pants from the street, washed-out shirts, flip-flops that are about to be separated -

A perfect instant noodle otaku standard!

The other two girls, one with yellow hair, one with pink hair, and those tattoos with great visual impact...

Don’t think about it for a second, you’re such a spirited girl!

Thinking of this, the cabinet sister looked at the three of them with a little more vigilance in her eyes.

Shouldn't you just watch and buy it?

Pure prostitution?

Luxury brand cosmetics stores offer free trials, and she has encountered many customers who only try but don't buy.

And we are still "repeat customers".

Out of professional ethics, she still forced out a smile and walked towards Jiang Chen and the others.

"Welcome, happy to serve you."

Jiang Chen nodded slightly, and then felt like he was back at home.

He glanced around, and then said to the two balls:

"You can pick whatever is under 1,000 yuan! Don't save money for me, or you'll fall out!"

"Okay, brother!"

The two energetic girls nodded solemnly, as if they were used to his domineering attitude.

Then they both went to the counter.

"Wow, this is the latest Dior!"

“Armani’s new lip gloss, I’ve been dreaming about buying a set!”

Looking at the various fashionable cosmetics, the two spirited girls looked like Grandma Liu entering the Grand View Garden.

From time to time there were bursts of exclamations.

There's nothing they don't like.

This cosmetics store is full of luxury brands, far away from the generic brands they usually use.

You can take a look at the price.

They both couldn't help but retreat.

It’s too expensive!

Wanzi looked at it again and again, and finally it was Jiang Chen's look that made her grit her teeth and make a decision.

"Brother Jiang, I like this KIKO bright color double-ended lip glaze very much. It's only...just over 100!" His voice was trembling.

I picked this one because it was the cheapest.

Jiang Chen glanced at the price and immediately frowned.

"Only over 100? How can I be worthy of you?"

Wanzi was stunned on the spot.
